metadata.description: Standard request flow: User input → React component → tRPC client → HTTP request → Express → tRPC context → router execution → Supabase/Stripe/AI → response → frontend → UI update
metadata.context: Describes the complete lifecycle of a request in PostSpark

metadata.description: Possible request inputs: text, URL, image, creation mode, post type, user identifier, plan and balance data
metadata.context: Lists the types of data that can enter the system

metadata.description: Possible request outputs: post variations, execution brief, error messages, saved data, billing status, background assets
metadata.context: Lists the types of data that can be returned from the system
